method: decision = shop relic slot or ancient relic option; deck+relics reconstructed at that floor. in(A): commit_A >= 0.4 and within 0.15 of the character's top commit; out(A): decisions leaning to another build of the same character. Rates player-balanced (10% cap), out act-standardised. fitRatio = (pickRateIn/pickRateOut) / (basePickRateIn/basePickRateOut) over all relics of the same signal. use = nIn>=30, eff_n>=20, fitRatio >=1.5 or <=1/1.5, direction stable in >=80% of 200 player bootstraps. presenceLift = final relics of wins, member = final commit >= commitThreshold without this relic.
basis: good = good players wins+losses; all = all players wins + good players losses (used when good is thin)
